subject.title: [Bug] Orphaned/oversized native Codex thread wedges a session permanently — chat.send returns started but no run executes, silently dropping messages

question: Should #86963 close on the existing Codex overflow rotation and WebChat error-surfacing guardrails, or require a targeted current-main replay/follow-up before close?
rationale: The remaining gap is the intended success boundary for non-blocking `chat.send` when Codex native-thread startup can wedge asynchronously, and that boundary is a product/runtime contract choice rather than a mechanical line edit.

options.title: Require targeted replay before close
options.body: Keep the issue open until a fixture or live Codex/WebChat replay proves the reported persisted-thread state now rotates or errors visibly after an accepted send.

options.title: Close on existing mitigations
options.body: Accept #88207 plus current post-ACK error surfacing as sufficient even without replaying the exact accepted/no-run wedge.

options.title: Change the ACK contract
options.body: Make Codex unsafe-thread preflight part of the `chat.send` success boundary so unrunnable sends fail or rotate before returning `started`.

recommendation.title: Require targeted replay before close
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a fixture or live Codex/WebChat replay proves the reported persisted-thread state now rotates or errors visibly after an accepted send.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing owner from the merged Codex recovery history and #88207 merge/hardening trail.
